_note: The Canadian Highlander Council as of the Fall 2026 update and the September 2026 council change. Photos are the public profile pictures each person uses on Moxfield; anyone without one gets a monogram. Sources are on canadianhighlander.ca.

members.name: Benjamin Wheeler
members.role: The voice of the points updates
members.bio: Ben usually posts the points announcements and talks through them in the council's videos. He won Highlander for Staples at Yellowjacket in 2014 with mono-green Craterhoof, and you'll hear him on LoadingReadyRun's North 100.

members.name: Robin Sorensen
members.bio: Robin is one of the players the official site credits with starting the format in Victoria. There's even a blue-green tempo deck named after him, "UG Sorensen."

members.name: Spencer Kanaka
members.bio: Spencer was one of the five councillors before the council grew in 2026. In the Fall 2026 update he was the only vote in favour of pointing Demonic Counsel.

members.name: Evan Pepper
members.role: Write-ups and the reasoning behind them
members.bio: Evan was also one of the original five. He co-wrote the March 2026 points update with Josh and Kelvin.

members.name: Kelvin Chen
members.role: Data, tournaments, and the manabase guide
members.bio: Kelvin joined when the council expanded in 2026. He runs tournaments, collects a lot of the data the council uses, and wrote the official articles on singleton mana bases and common deck-building questions.

members.name: Joshua Gottlieb
members.bio: Josh joined with Kelvin in 2026. He organizes events, has done a lot to make format info easier to find, and was the lead writer on the March 2026 update.

members.name: Trenton M.
members.bio: Trenton is a Victoria regular who joined in September 2026. He makes Canlander videos with Liam and Jer on LJT MTG and has played just about everything, from Jeskai and Jund to Cradlehoof, Mono Red and Flash Hulk.

sources.label: An Update to the Council, September 2026
